feeds.title: Painted Furniture Ideas
feeds.description: Hello!! I'm Genevre and I Love DIY projects and furniture makeovers. Check out my painted furniture, tips and tutorials on my website.

feeds.title: The Painted Drawer Blog
feeds.description: The Painted Drawer is full of up-cycled, design on a dime inspiration with fantastic paint and decorating tips and tutorials for your home! From how-to posts on flipping furniture, thrifting for finds, home DIY, recipes to share and beauty tips and tricks, it is all here to share!

feeds.title: Paint Me White
feeds.description: My name is Sandy and I am a decorative painter and pleased to say that we are a Stockist for Jolie Premier Paints. I have a passion for upcycling old furniture. I am a collector a treasure hunter and see the beauty in what pieces can be rather than what they currently are. I love beautiful things shabby, rustic, beachy, french and anything that is recycled.
